source_text:
σαφῶς προγεγραμμένον τε καὶ προδεδηλωμένον καὶ τὸ τῆς ἁγίας Τριάδος
ἀποῤῥητότατον καὶ μυστικώτατον δόγμα, σαφῶς ἐξ ὀνόματος Πατέρα καὶ Υἱὸν καὶ
ἅγιον Πνεῦμα ἐμφαινούσης καὶ σημαινούσης καὶ μυσταγωγούσης τῆς τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ
προσηγορίας, κατὰ τὴν τοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν ἐπὶ τῆς θεολογίας
ἀριδηλοτάτην ὀνομασίαν καὶ ἀπαρίθμησιν καὶ παράδοσιν.
pass_a_gloss: Close of the transitional sentence: heaven’s gift of the new name shows that the church’s most unspeakable and most hidden teaching about the Trinity was already drawn in outline and declared ahead of time. Abraham’s name itself performs a triple service — showing, meaning, and ushering readers into the mystery of Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. This matches how Christ the Savior plainly named, counted, and handed down the three in his teaching about the Godhead.
pass_b_english: clearly outlined beforehand and proclaimed beforehand the most ineffable and most mystical doctrine of the holy Trinity as well. The name of Abraham plainly displaying, signifying, and initiating into the mystery the Father and the Son and the holy Spirit — in agreement with the most manifest naming and numbering and handing down of Christ our Savior in the doctrine of God (Matthew 28:19).

choices.choice: Inline citation: Christ’s naming and numbering is the baptismal formula.
In the doctrine of God: patristic theology, not modern academic theology.
Continues the sentence begun in frag-rem-mid.
